name: Payload LauncherX
description: Native PS5 homebrew USB payload launcher with a controller-friendly blue neon interface. Automatically discovers payloads from /mnt/usb0/payloads/, reads names, descriptions, versions and authors from payload.json, displays local payload icons, supports sorting and refreshing, and launches selected ELF payloads through an already running elfldr service on localhost port 9021.
author: YAHBALLON
